verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a parameterized API for Document AI. The docs cover OCR request parameters (table_format, include_blocks, confidence_scores_granularity), input options (URL, Base64, upload), official Python and TypeScript SDKs, and a /v1/batch endpoint. A community user confirms that submitting via the API worked where the chat UI failed. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and the explicit OCR endpoint path and API reference pages in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
